result.edit: Fix the first-bit routing at the completion of a failed group: in state sf6 the next group's first bit was inverted (data=1 -> s1, data=0 -> sf1). Correct it to `nstate=data?sf1:s1` so a 0 as the first bit starts the match path and a 1 skips the group, matching the 011100 target. Also normalize the reset check to `if(!rst_n)`.
result.repair_experience_summary: Group-based sequence detector for 011100; failure state sf6 must route the next group's first bit identically to s6 (0 -> s1, 1 -> sf1).
